assets.title: Three-Zone Fixed Roundabout Platform
assets.description: One original low-poly low roundabout exterior in one fixed static pose. A wide grounded circular base joins a solid vertical shaft and a finite horizontal shoulder. A genuinely through-bored flanged centre sleeve rests on the complete shoulder face; the thick circular platform rests on the sleeve flange. Positive air separates the shaft from the complete bore wall and the deck from the base outside its support. Three continuous rounded U-shaped radial rails each have two finite embedded ends in the deck, dividing three open platform areas with clear outer entrances. The deck is one closed annular solid with alternating muted teal top sectors and a dark edge; the warm ochre rails and sleeve remain individually editable. One complete assembly counts as one prop. Metres, Z up, origin at ground beneath the centre axis. Constant opaque PBR colours only, no textures, people, seats, canopy, ground scene, logos or added accessories. Static visual geometry only: no rotation, animation, bearing performance, friction, ride simulation, multi-person use, child or adult suitability, age guidance, clearances for bodies, motion balance, entrapment protection, centrifugal loads, structural capacity, stability, installation, manufacturing specification or playground/safety certification. No claimed compatibility with old playground scenes or other assets.
